caption: Valère Basilica, Sion
composition: Sion looking up to the fortified Valère Basilica, with Tourbillon on the opposite hill · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The fortified Valère Basilica crowns its hill above Sion, a Romanesque and Gothic church inside a walled hilltop borough, with a square belfry and the old canon houses. The ruined Tourbillon castle occupies the opposite hill. Dry late-September grass and the valley town sit below. The Open-Meteo model is partly cloudy and warm, and no scaffolding is added.
